text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few months have passed since the 
discovery of that hidden hot spring. 
Yukoma Hot Spring Village was gradually 
livening up.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
The detailed component analysis is 
complete. As expected, it has an entirely 
new spring quality, quite different from 
conventional hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my! And what might those intriguing 
effects be...?"

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Simply put, it was an 'all-purpose cure'♪ 
Rough skin, stiff shoulders, chronic 
fatigue. Even post-injury and illness 
recovery...!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
The minerals condensed deep underground 
for so many years seem like they'll work 
wonders.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
All the necessary permits have been 
cleared. Starting today, we begin 
full-scale excavation!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice, yeah♪ An' once the new bath is 
built...! We can kick back an' relax 
again.

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a new bathhouse...? Come to think of 
it, I did see a news story about 'A Hidden 
Hot Spring Discovered!' the other day.

text_block_list.name: Tourist B
text_block_list.text:
Huh~ they're adding more hot springs? 
Maybe I'll come back once they're 
finished.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Please look forward 
to it.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
The other guests seem curious about the 
hidden hot spring as well.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
It looks like there are still plenty of 
spots left to excavate, so let's do our 
best to liven things up!
